tools.name: search_podcast_sponsorships
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which brands sponsor Spanish-language podcasts or YouTube channels, optionally filtered by brand, show, country or only ads with a promo code. Returns individual sponsorship placements from the last 30 days: brand, show, country, episode date, promo code, offer and links.

tools.name: get_brand_podcast_sponsorships
tools.description: Use this when the user asks where a specific brand advertises in Spanish-language podcasts or YouTube channels, which shows it sponsors, or which promo codes it uses there. tools.name: get_podcast_sponsors
tools.description: Use this when the user asks who sponsors a specific Spanish-language podcast or YouTube channel, or which promo codes it reads. Returns each sponsoring brand in the last 30 days with episode counts, last date, codes and offers. If the name is ambiguous it returns candidate show names instead.

tools.name: list_top_podcast_sponsors
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which brands sponsor the most Spanish-language podcasts or YouTube channels, overall or in one country. Returns brands ranked by number of different shows sponsored in the last 30 days.

tools.name: find_sponsor_leads_for_podcast
tools.description: Use this when a podcaster, network or agency asks which brands they could pitch for sponsorship. Takes a Spanish-language show and returns brands that sponsored similar shows in the last 30 days but did not sponsor this show.
